limitations: The Monday candle/range engine requires chart timeframe <=1D; on weekly/monthly it is gated while 1H rays, fixed-15m key levels and oscillator remain available.
History bounded by 12000 source hours and retained signal count; lower available source history can reduce it. Coarse charts visually overlap nearby hourly rays.
Pine total 500-line budget reserves ray slots and can shorten oldest historical Fib segments at high retention settings.
Display implementation, not a profitability or combined trading system validation.
